final_message:
All six visible tests now pass. I fixed three bugs:

1. **`ledger/parse.py`, `parse_date`**: it returned `(year, day, month)`. It now returns `(year, month, day)`.
2. **`ledger/money.py`, `format_cents`**: negative amounts were formatted with floor division and modulo, so `-310` came out as `-$-4.90`. It now uses the absolute value, so `-310` gives `-$3.10` and `-5` gives `-$0.05`.
3. **`ledger/report.py`, `top_items`**: it sorted by total ascending. It now sorts by total descending, with ties broken by item name ascending, as the docstring says. `summary_line` uses `top_items`, so it is fixed too.

I only ran the visible tests plus a quick check of `format_cents` on a few negative values and zero. I didn't test `parse_amount` or `parse_ledger` beyond what the visible tests cover.
